learning_outcomes.text: Write clear, testable prompts with explicit instructions, roles and output contracts
Apply few-shot examples, structured output and delimiters to control model behaviour
Decompose complex tasks and use reasoning-elicitation techniques appropriately
Build prompts that degrade safely and handle ambiguous or adversarial input
Version, test and regression-check prompts like code
Reduce cost and latency by trimming prompts without losing quality

integrative_case: A product team ships an LLM feature that classifies and routes customer messages: write a prompt with an explicit output contract, add few-shot examples only where they help, harden it against injection and empty input, put it under version control with a regression suite, and trim tokens to hit a latency budget.
